sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. This is a significant opportunity to extend their lead, as they face Alsager Town, who sit bottom of the league with just 4 points and are in dire form with only one win in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could be crucial in the title race, with Stafford looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face Eccleshall at home in a meeting of two strong teams, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals host fellow promotion-chasers at Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town, fifth, visit Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a clash between mid-table sides, while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town seeking to arrest their recent struggles. Crewe face Allscott Heath, and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-battle between two of the division's poorest-performing teams. Brereton Social's visit to Widnes Town is another low-table fixture, with Widnes in particularly dire straits at the foot of the league with just 2 points.
